Its derivative, complementary-angle symmetry, and uniformly bounded fifth-order Taylor remainder prove the remaining claims. The actual embedded verify.py was run successfully in its staging location. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Two independently motivated structural gaps are closed: the exact complete set of body-independent deterministic area-contraction offsets for every odd cyclic constant-width class, and the full angular mixed-area profile of its geometrically canonical Reuleaux minimizer family for all odd orders beyond n=3. Exact complementary-area law, strict optimizer monotonicity, and a dimensionless cubic scaling limit enrich the classification. A smooth single-mode counterexample proves the Reuleaux monotonicity is not a formal consequence of symmetry, and the values are natural geometric area deficits rather than arbitrary slices.
